description: Open blockers and watched conditions that can stop or delay orchestrated work.

blockers.title: Physical-device installation is not approved
blockers.detail: adb install of release/yomira-v5.1.0-beta.apk on M2007J3SY (serial b4bc1593) failed with INSTALL_FAILED_USER_RESTRICTED: Install canceled by user. Package com.yomira.app was absent before and after the attempt; launch is unverified.
blockers.workaround: Proceed with build, static verification and test authoring. The 10-minute test and offline drill start only after the owner enables USB installation and approves the prompt.
exitCriteria: Launch resolves an activity and the app reaches the library screen

watchItems.title: Dated model inventory may drift from live availability
watchItems.impact: Dispatch may target a retired or renamed endpoint.
watchItems.trigger: Model-not-found, 404/410, or a catalog export that differs from providers.json.
watchItems.response: Pause, record a blocker, refresh the inventory snapshot, re-plan affected assignments.

watchItems.title: AniList quota and 5xx behavior is unmeasured
watchItems.impact: Adaptation shelves could be empty or slow during PHASE-4.
watchItems.trigger: First poll of AniList rate headers or a 429 in integration testing.
watchItems.response: Tune the throttle budget, verify backoff and cache behavior, record measured limits in benchmarks.json if a suite applies.

watchItems.title: Provider pricing and plan terms are unknown
watchItems.impact: Spend cannot be reported and paid overflow cannot be justified.
watchItems.trigger: A provider invoice, plan change or proposed paid overflow.
watchItems.response: Ask the owner for a dated price sheet; keep cost null until supplied.

notes: No blocker currently prevents PHASE-2 or PHASE-3 work from starting after their dependencies complete.
A blocker closes only when its exit criteria are met and the evidence is linked.
